name: anonymous-install
body: Installing, upgrading or manually downloading kalide is anonymous: the repo really-knows-ai/kalide is public and every release asset, the tap and the bucket are fetched without a GitHub account, repo access or token (no `HOMEBREW_GITHUB_API_TOKEN`, no `KALIDE_GITHUB_TOKEN`). Shipped install artifacts (formula, Scoop manifest, docs) reference only public, tokenless download mechanisms.
